entities.summary: Mark Lunsford Pryor is an American attorney, politician and lobbyist who served as a United States senator from Arkansas from 2003 to 2015. He previously served as Attorney General of Arkansas from 1999 to 2003 and in the Arkansas House of Representatives from 1991 to 1995. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Mark Pryor was a legal figures from Fayetteville (b. 1963-01-10, Fayetteville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
